title: Show/hide log line toggle lives in LogLineDetailsLog, not the Log Details header
answers: Where is the show/hide log line button now?
How do I toggle the log line visibility from Log Details?
Log line eye icon moved from header
How does hiding/showing the log body field work in Log Details?
body:
The eye-icon toggle to show/hide the log line body (LOG_LINE_BODY_FIELD_NAME) was moved out of LogLineDetailsHeader into LogLineDetailsLog, rendered inline with filter actions next to the log line text. It only appears when onClickShowField and onClickHideField are both provided via LogListContext and displayedFields is non-empty (showLogLineToggle), i.e. only when displayed-fields mode is in use. Toggling reports interaction logs_log_line_details_toggle_log_clicked with action show/hide.
Any future change to log-line visibility controls should be made in LogLineDetailsLog.tsx, not the header component.
applies: Log Details log line section and header (LogLineDetailsLog.tsx, LogLineDetailsHeader.tsx)
